meta.title: The vendor re-bids after a rejection that allowed it
gaps: Start from a bid explicitly rejected with "Allow seller to bid again" enabled.
Verify that submission time was extended before the re-bid.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Start from a bid explicitly rejected with "Allow seller to bid again" enabled.; Verify that submission time was extended before the re-bid.

steps.note: Open the prepared event with its existing vendor bid; this is the required starting state for prepared bid cases.
Move to Vendor A's supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's pricing round so Vendor A can submit the re-bid.
Submit Vendor A's new quote at 95.
Verify the vendor portal accepted the new bid and shows the round as Submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page to verify the buyer-side results.
Open the Responses view where the buyer should see Vendor A's submitted response.
Verify the buyer sees Vendor A's direct response after the re-bid.
Open Master QCS to verify the re-bid is included in the comparison grid.
Verify Master QCS shows the newly submitted bid price of 95.
Verify the accepted re-bid is ranked again in Master QCS.
